dram_address_space.basis: The X-T30 2.01 memory-plan tables place buffers up to 0x80000000: the last planned buffer starts at 0x7f975000 with a size of 0x68b000 and ends there, and no planned buffer ends above it. The software-visible DRAM space therefore ends at 0x80000000 (2 GiB); the installed capacity is not measured.
